Class CompanyRepMenu

java.lang.Object
App.CompanyRepMenu
public class CompanyRepMenu extends Object
Handles all menu display and operation logic specific to the CompanyRepresentative role. This class provides methods for creating, viewing, editing, deleting internships, and managing applications.

  • Method Details

    • displayMenu

      public int displayMenu()
      Display company representative menu and get user choice
      Returns:
      User choice (1-9)

    • createInternship

      public void createInternship(CompanyRepresentative rep)
      Guides the representative through the process of creating a new internship. Collects all required details (title, dates, slots, etc.) and validates input formats. The new internship is added to the representative's list and the global list.
      Parameters:
      rep - The currently logged-in CompanyRepresentative.

    • viewMyInternships

      public void viewMyInternships(CompanyRepresentative rep)
      Displays a list of all internships created by the representative, optionally allowing the user to filter the list by status before display. It uses the inherited filterInternships and displayInternships methods.
      Parameters:
      rep - The currently logged-in CompanyRepresentative.

    • editInternship

      public void editInternship(CompanyRepresentative rep)
      Allows the representative to modify the details of an existing internship. Edits are only permitted if the internship status is "Pending" (before staff approval).
      Parameters:
      rep - The currently logged-in CompanyRepresentative.

    • deleteInternship

      public void deleteInternship(CompanyRepresentative rep)
      Allows the representative to delete an internship opportunity. Deletion is prevented if the internship has been approved by the Career Centre staff.
      Parameters:
      rep - The currently logged-in CompanyRepresentative.

    • manageApplications

      public void manageApplications(CompanyRepresentative rep)
      Allows the representative to select an internship, view its ranked applications, and then approve or reject a specific Application. Status changes are delegated to the ApplicationViewer.
      Parameters:
      rep - The currently logged-in CompanyRepresentative.

    • toggleVisibility

      public void toggleVisibility(CompanyRepresentative rep)
      Toggles the visibility status of a selected internship. The operation is delegated to the CompanyRepresentative's changeVisibility method.
      Parameters:
      rep - The currently logged-in CompanyRepresentative.
